courses.title: CALCULUS AND PROBABILITY WITH BIOLOGICAL APPLICATIONS
courses.prereqText: One or more of Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Mathematics 1225A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B, or the former Applied Mathematics 1412A/B.
courses.antireqText: Calculus 1301A/B, Calculus 1501A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B, or the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B.

courses.title: ORDINARY DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Calculus 1301A/B, or a minimum mark of 55% in Calculus 1501A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B or the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B or the former Applied Mathematics 1413. Integrated Science 1001X with a minimum mark of 60% can be used in place of Calculus 1301A/B. Pre-or Corequisite(s): Mathematics 1600A/B or Mathematics 1700A/B.

courses.title: MATHEMATICAL COMPUTATION
courses.prereqText: Mathematics 1700A/B or a minimum mark of 55% in Mathematics 1600A/B. Pre-or Corequisite(s): Calculus 2302A/B, Calculus 2402A/B or Mathematics 2500A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2276A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2277A/B or the former Calculus 2502A/B.

courses.title: MATHEMATICAL BIOLOGY
courses.prereqText: One of Calculus 2302A/B, Calculus 2402A/B, Calculus 2502A/B; plus one of Mathematics 1600A/B, Mathematics 1700A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1411A/B, or the former Applied Mathematics 1411A/B.

courses.title: COMPLEX VARIABLES WITH APPLICATIONS
courses.prereqText: Calculus 2303A/B or Mathematics 2500A/B or the former Calculus 2503A/B.

courses.title: NONLINEAR ORDINARY DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS AND CHAOS
courses.prereqText: Calculus 2503A/B; one of Applied Mathematics 2402A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2270A/B.

courses.title: PARTIAL DIFFERENTIAL EQUATIONS I
courses.prereqText: Calculus 2402A/B or Calculus 2503A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2276A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2277A/B; Applied Mathematics 2402A/B or Statistical Sciences 2503A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2270A/B. In each course a minimum mark of 60% is required.

courses.title: MATHEMATICAL MODELLING
courses.prereqText: Applied Mathematics 2402A/B; Calculus 2303A/B or Mathematics 2500A/B or the former Calculus 2502A/B; plus one of Mathematics 1600A/B, Mathematics 1700A/B.

courses.title: MATHEMATICAL BIOLOGY
courses.prereqText: One of Calculus 2302A/B, Calculus 2402A/B, Mathematics 2500A/B, the former Calculus 2502A/B; plus one of Mathematics 1600A/B, Mathematics 1700A/B, NMM 1411A/B.

courses.title: DISEASE MODELLING
courses.prereqText: Applied Mathematics 2402A/B or Statistical Sciences 2503A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 2270A/B. Recommended: Applied Mathematics 3615A/B and Applied Mathematics 2814A/B as pre- or co-requisites.
courses.antireqText: Applied Mathematics 3615A/B, if taken in the 2020-21 or 2021-22, and Mathematics 4958B, if taken in 2022-23 with the topic “Covid Modelling”.

courses.title: INTRODUCTION TO NEURAL NETWORKS
courses.prereqText: Applied Mathematics 3813A/B and Applied Mathematics 3815A/B or with the permission of the Department of Mathematics.

courses.title: INTRODUCTION TO APPLIED COMPUTER ALGEBRA
courses.prereqText: Applied Mathematics 2814F/G or the former Applied Mathematics 2413, the former Applied Mathematics 2415.

courses.title: PROJECT
courses.prereqText: Registration in the fourth year of a module offered by the Department of Mathematics and permission of the department.
